headline: Tournament organizers deploy retired undercover squirrels to negotiate badminton court usage with local monkey troupe
body:
The organizing committee for the upcoming BWF World Championships in Delhi has confirmed the recruitment of twelve highly-trained, former intelligence-agency squirrels to act as mediators between stadium staff and the local troupe of rhesus macaques. The squirrels, equipped with miniature high-visibility vests, have been tasked with convincing the monkeys to restrict their mid-match court occupation to the training halls only.

“The negotiations are delicate, but the squirrels are fluent in tail-twitching protocols that the monkeys seem to respect,” said Suresh Varma, the Lead Ornithology Liaison for the tournament. “We previously attempted to play recordings of predatory birds, but the pigeons simply started using the sound as a rhythm track for their own dance-offs, which only served to further confuse the shuttlers during high-speed smashes.”

To further discourage aerial disruptions, the committee has also introduced a 'Pigeon-Friendly Zone' near the parking lot, complete with premium quality millet and a small scoreboard. Officials hope that if the pigeons feel adequately appreciated for their officiating skills, they will stop attempting to participate in the actual men’s singles matches as uninvited ball-retrievers.
caption: Squirrels in vests? Yes, please. Delhi's badminton setup is getting a wild upgrade to deal with our furry, feathered visitors. Who knew diplomacy was this tiny? 🏸🐒 #DelhiBadminton #WildlifeDiplomacy #BWFWorldChampionships (satire)
